run.name: Belden Inc.
run.title: CP-OS host session (BDC)
run.summary: Belden has strong liquidity but, after the debt-funded Ruckus purchase, much higher leverage that rests on unproven acquired earnings. The credit view is cautious and depends on Ruckus delivering. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context; the EDGAR registrant name in that context is BELDEN INC..

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Debt before unamortised costs (USD 3,103.780 million) over LTM Adjusted EBITDA (USD 557.166 million = FY2025 plus nine months 2026 less nine months 2025). Ruckus is included for one quarter only; debt includes all of Term Loan B. Overstated against a full-year combined base. Company Adjusted EBITDA, not a covenant definition.

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. Adjusted EBITDA USD 458.734 million over interest paid USD 43.157 million (10-K page 107). Pre-Ruckus capital structure.

cash.basis: Cash. Cash USD 380.706 million, of which USD 232.0 million is held outside the U.S. (10-Q Q3 pages 2 and 34); availability (page 18). The shortfall to the USD 400.0 million commitment is not explained in the sources.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Term loan terms, Ruckus earnings history and ratings are not supplied.
CP-1 main limitation: No pro forma EBITDA for Ruckus is supplied, so a full-year combined leverage ratio cannot be calculated.
